items.t: KKR to Present at the Goldman Sachs 2026 Financial Services Conference
items.sum: NEW YORK, November 23, 2026--KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE: KKR) announced today that Joseph Y. Bae, Co-Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Goldman Sachs 2026 Financial Services Conference on Tuesday, December 8, 2026 at 8:40AM ET.

items.t: KKR (KKR) Pushes Into Data Centers, Renewables And Music Rights
items.sum: KKR (NYSE:KKR) unit Helix Digital Infrastructure is in advanced talks to buy a majority stake in EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure in a multi billion dollar deal. Separately, KKR has agreed to a minority investment in Gentari's Indian renewables platform, expanding its presence in clean energy assets.
